A.Purpose:

To document the Billing Process with the aim that:

  • The accuracy of billing is maintained.
  • The customer has full satisfaction in the billing details.

B.Scope of department:

This covers both in patients as well as outpatient in all areas of hospital.

C. Responsibility:

Billing and accounts department is responsible for billing.

D.Types of Billing Payments:

The payments of following facilities are chargeable in the hospital:

  • OP and IP Registration.
  • Diagnostics and Investigation.
  • Surgical services.
  • Patient accommodation in private/semiprivate and paying ward.

E. OPD Consultation, Registration, Investigation payments

The OPD registration is charged for a minimum fixed period. If patient visits the hospital after the defined period, needs to pay again after this specified period diagnostics are also chargeable.

OPD, IPD, Accommodation charges and laboratory investigation charges are collected in the main registration counter.

F. In Patient’s Billing System.

As soon as the patient is informed to get admitted by the treating consultant, separate Inpatient registration of the patient is being done at the registration counter (during normal working hours ) and in the emergency department of the hospital (during non peak hours ) .

During the treatment, the patient is charged for all the procedures and test

As the treating consultant orders to discharge the patient, nursing staff prepares the details for the patient stay in hospital and directs the patient relative to billing department.

The in charge clerk look prepares the bill and accordingly the amount is collected from patient relative. Duly signed payment slip is provided as proof of payment which is attached to the patients file and a copy is stored by the accounts department. Entry is done in cash receipt book.

Patient relative comes to ward, shows the receipt book and get patient discharged.
